description: This file defines the WorkExperience Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides functionality to represent and normalize an employee's work experience data, including retrieving related employee information and mapping fields for reporting purposes.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing an employee's work experience, capable of normalizing its data for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkExperience object with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the work experience data to an array based on specified fields, retrieving employee experience information.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to methods used to retrieve their values.
